request.description: Minecraft blocky voxel landscape at blue hour, pixel art: on a grassy cliff to the right stands a ruined observatory built from grey tuff bricks with an oxidized teal-green copper dome, a thin teal light beam rising from it into a starry dark teal sky. Below, a valley of dark spruce and oak forest with a river. Cubic block terrain, blocky clouds, calm and dark on the left third. Wide establishing shot.
